properties.name: transfer.fee.strategy
properties.description: Transfer fee strategy: FLAT, PERCENTAGE or FREE_TIER

properties.name: transfer.fee.flat.amount
properties.description: Fixed fee charged per transfer (FLAT strategy)

properties.name: transfer.fee.percentage.rate
properties.description: Fee as a percentage of the transfer amount, e.g. 1.5 for 1.5% (PERCENTAGE strategy)

properties.name: transfer.fee.percentage.min
properties.description: Minimum fee for the PERCENTAGE strategy

properties.name: transfer.fee.percentage.max
properties.description: Maximum fee for the PERCENTAGE strategy; unset means no cap

properties.name: transfer.fee.free-tier.free-transfers-per-month
properties.description: Number of fee-free transfers per account per calendar month (FREE_TIER strategy)

properties.name: transfer.fee.free-tier.paid-strategy
properties.description: Strategy (FLAT or PERCENTAGE) applied once the free tier is exhausted
